66    private void assertPolicy(JSONObject json) {
67      assertEquals("title", json.get("title"));
68      assertEquals(TargetType.EVENT.toString(), json.get("targetType"));
69      assertEquals(Action.START_WORKFLOW.toString(), json.get("action"));
70      assertEquals("{\"workflowId\":\"noop\",\"workflowParameters\":\"{}\"}", json.get("actionParameters"));
71  
72      assertEquals("2023-11-30T16:16:47Z", json.get("actionDate"));
73      assertEquals(Timing.SPECIFIC_DATE.toString(), json.get("timing"));
74  
75      assertEquals("{}", json.get("targetFilters"));
76  
77      final JSONArray accessControlEntries = (JSONArray) json.get("accessControlEntries");
78      assertEquals(1, accessControlEntries.size());
79  
80      final JSONObject accessControlEntry = (JSONObject) accessControlEntries.get(0);
81      assertEquals(true, accessControlEntry.get("allow"));
82      assertEquals("ROLE_USER_BOB", accessControlEntry.get("role"));
83      assertEquals("read", accessControlEntry.get("action"));
84    }
85  
86    @Test
87    public void testGetPolicy() throws Exception {
88      String response = given()
89          .pathParam("id", POLICY_ID)
90          .expect()
91          .statusCode(SC_OK).when()
92          .get(env.host("/policies/{id}"))
93          .asString();
94  
95      assertPolicy((JSONObject) parser.parse(response));
96    }
97  
98    @Test
99    public void testGetPolicyThatDoesNotExist() throws Exception {
100     given()
101         .pathParam("id", MISSING_POLICY_ID)
102         .expect()
103         .statusCode(SC_NOT_FOUND).when()
104         .get(env.host("/policies/{id}"));
105   }

116   @Test
117   public void testGetPolicies() throws Exception {
118     String response = given()
119         .queryParam("limit", 100)
120         .queryParam("offset", 0)
121         .queryParam("sortByUpdated", false)
122         .queryParam("sortByUpdatedAscending", false)
123         .expect()
124         .statusCode(SC_OK).when()
125         .get(env.host("/policies"))
126         .asString();
127 
128     JSONObject responseObj = (JSONObject) parser.parse(response);
129     final JSONArray policies = (JSONArray) responseObj.get("results");
130     assertPolicy((JSONObject) policies.get(0));
131   }
